key: h1_key of h1_sha256.py: normalize.match_key, then NFKC, casefold, whitespace runs to one space
shingles: word 5-grams of the key as 8-byte BLAKE2b digests; a key under 5 words is one shingle
matrix_definition: distinct documents in row source with another qualifying H1/H2 match in column source / row source documents

duplicate_rules.math: word Jaccard >= 0.90; identical signed number multisets
duplicate_rules.code: token Jaccard >= 0.85; both >= 20 nonblank lines after comment removal
duplicate_rules.mixed_domains: both domains' rules must pass on both documents
duplicate_rules.h1: same H1 SHA256; bypasses H2 guards
